fullContentHtml:
UP SCVTUP ITI First Allotment Result 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : State Council for Vocational Training, UP has released the first allotment result for the Government and Private College ITI Admission 2026. Applications for the UPTET Online Form 2026 were accepted from 11 July 2026 to 07 August 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their UP SCVTUP ITI First Allotment Result 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 11 July 2026
  • Last Date : 07 August 2026 (Extended)
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 04 August 2026
  • Merit List Issued : 27 August 2026
  • Counseling Begin : As per Schedule

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 300/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 250/-
  • All Female : Rs. 100/-
  • Pay the Examination Fee Through Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, E Challan, E Wallet, Cash Card Fee Mode Only.

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is UP SCVTUP ITI First Allotment Result 2026?

UP SCVTUP ITI First Allotment Result 2026 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

What is the last date to apply?

The last date to apply is 07 August 2026 (Extended).

Where can I find the official website?

The official website is: https://scvtup.in/

How to download result?

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
